theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p : ℝ), (n : ℝ) < p → V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V.LocallyLp H p → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ V.mult x = k) → ∀ ξ ∈ U, V.HasDensity ξ 1 → ∀ (R : ℝ) (Q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ), 0 < R → closedBall ξ R ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 R) → Q '' ((fun x => x - ξ) '' V.support) ∩ ball 0 R = graphOver u (ball 0 R) ∩ ball 0 R → ∃ s > 0, s ≤ R ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, x ∈ ball ξ s → V.mult x = 1) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (symmDiff (V.carrier ∩ ball ξ s) (V.support ∩ ball ξ s)) = 0 ∧ V.weight.restrict (ball ξ s) = (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (V.support ∩ ball ξ s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ ball ξ s ∩ V.support, V.HasDensity y 1) ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ s → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (symmDiff (Q '' ((fun x => x - ξ) '' V.carrier) ∩ ball 0 ρ) (graphOver u {x | x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) ρ ∧ ‖graphPoint x (u x)‖ < ρ})) = 0
